faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in Langley: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom townhome in Langley right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in Langley, 146 sold over the past year at a median of $696,000, with the middle half between $655,625 and $749,975.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom townhomes in Langley selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 20 days, and homes sold for 97.9% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Langley sell the most 2 bedroom townhomes?
faq.a: Willoughby Heights, with 87 of the 146 sales at a median of $685,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Langley have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Red Maple Park (6 sales, median $678,500); York by Mosaic (5 sales, median $710,000); Exchange (5 sales, median $647,500); Sagebrook (5 sales, median $650,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in Langley?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in Langley was $345 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in Langley compare
A 2 bedroom townhome in Langley sold for $143,900 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($696,000 against $839,900, 550 sales). The strata fee was $345 a month against $346.
Of the 6 cities with 2 bedroom townhome pages, Langley has the second highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $388,750 and South Surrey highest at $780,000.
